title: Blueshift International Materials
content:
Blueshift International Materials, Inc. is a US advanced materials company founded in 2013 and based in Spencer, Massachusetts, originating from NASA Glenn Research Center technology licenses. Its flagship AeroZero is a thin, flexible polyimide aerogel film about 85% air, delivering very low thermal conductivity for thermal protection in aircraft, spacecraft, defense systems, batteries, medical devices and electronics. The company also produces PhaseBlue, an ultra-low dielectric, PFAS-free aerogel material for high-frequency electronics.

Blueshift holds AS9100D and ISO 9001:2015 certifications and cites five years of space heritage, offering buyers co-development support and custom formats for lightweight thermal management.
excerpt: Maker of AeroZero polyimide aerogel films and PhaseBlue low-dielectric materials for aerospace, defense and electronics thermal management.
